messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: synthetic-canary-eu-1 failing threshold (5/5 failures in 2m) - severity: page
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered: INC-8472 - Synthetic Canary Failures (eu-west-1)
pagerduty: Acknowledged by Sam (on-call) at 2478004330
Sam (on-call): looking. seeing lots of http 502s from canary prober -> target inference host pool. tagging Mike and Priya.
Mike H: @Sam on it — recent deploy to runtime nodepool-eu last hour? any rolling updates still running?
Priya S: no rolling updates scheduled. I can pull logs from prober and target app. starting with canary prober logs.
Sam (on-call): copy. running quick check: `kubectl -n synthetic get pods -l app=canary-prober -o wide`
Sam (on-call): pod synthetic-prober-eu-3 CrashLoopBackOff on node g4dn-xx-11
Priya S: grabbing prober logs: ```
2026-03-14T12:05:01Z ERROR request failed target=run-redwood-eu-02 status=502 body="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-14T12:05:02Z ERROR request failed target=run-redwood-eu-03 status=502 body="connection reset by peer"
``` 
Sam (on-call): target pool shows increased 5xxs around same window. likely networking or runtime OOM on a subset.
Mike H: checking node metrics: node g4dn-xx-11 memory spike, cgroup OOM kills around 12:04Z. looks like a noisy model init spilled memory during an autoscale event.
Priya S: ok we should: 1) remove that node from rotation 2) restart canary prober pods 3) open a paged escalation to L2 if errors persist. starting step 1.
Sam (on-call): scaling down problematic pod and cordoning node g4dn-xx-11: `kubectl cordon g4dn-xx-11 && kubectl drain g4dn-xx-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
pagerduty: Note: INC-8472 escalated to Jules (L2) at 2478004350
Jules (L2): on it. thx for the context. I see the same OOM kills in kubelet logs. will check model init logs (runtime) for the hot path.
Mike H: restarted canary prober deployment: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/canary-prober -n synthetic` — monitoring.
Sam (on-call): canaries recovering? prober probes passing now 3/5 success in last minute, still flaky.
Priya S: users? No customer-facing errors reported yet. but internal SLOs for synth checks failing triggers paging — low customer impact for now. logging this in incident timeline.
Jules (L2): found root cause hypothesis: autoscaler launched a new runtime pod with an older quantized model image that has a mem leak during first init. putting a quick fix: pin new image tag and prevent autoscaler from creating more until rollout verified.
Jules (L2): patching deployment: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime-pool-eu runtime=image:redwood-runtime:2026-03-14-hotfix` and scaling to desired count after image stabilizes.
Sam (on-call): acknowledging handoff: I'll stay on watch for 30m then hand to Priya for postmortem. @Jules please confirm when autoscaler reenabled.
Jules (L2): autoscaler paused via patch to HPA minReplicas=desired for now. will re-enable after 30m of green.
Mike H: added temporary alert suppression for the synthetic-check channel so we don't get paged while we verify (suppression-id: sup-6621) :wave: :thumbsup:
Priya S: documenting mitigation steps in the incident board and will start a draft postmortem once stabilized. linking playbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/synthetic-canary-failures
Sam (on-call): leaving final note: impact: synth checks failing in eu-west for ~4m, no customer-facing errors observed, root cause suspected model image mem leak during autoscale init, mitigation applied (cordon/drain bad node, restart prober, pin runtime image, pause autoscaler). handing to Priya for follow-up.
Priya S: acked handoff. I'm taking over for postmortem and long-term fix tracking. will notify channel before re-enabling autoscaler and removing suppression.
incident-bot: Incident INC-8472 updated: status=mitigated (monitoring), assigned=Priya S, priority=high
Sam (on-call): thanks everyone. closing active page but keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
